description: This file defines the ReadableOrderList class, which is a data transfer object used to encapsulate a list of orders with pagination information in a shopping cart or order management system.

classes.name: ReadableOrderList
classes.description: A data container representing a list of readable orders along with total count, extending ServiceEntity for common entity features.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders in the list.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total number of orders.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableOrder objects.

methods.name: setOrders
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableOrder objects.
